DRIVEN BY vc 2026-09-10, BOTH COMMAND FORMS, AGAINST THE LIVE 45h CONFIG -- NOT TAKEN FROM cc'S REPORT. `bin/prez showreel build <reel> --out <path>` and `bin/utilz prez showreel build <reel> --out <path>`, both exit 0, both reporting "23 slides, 5.2 MB self-contained, theme=.../popupart, pace=attract". The reel is `.../45h/showreel` with its real `showreel.yaml` -- `target: 1920`, `theme: popupart` -- and `SHOWREEL_THEME_PATH` set, which this row already rules is fixture setup rather than defect.
THE TWO COMMAND FORMS EXIST, AND THAT WAS MEASURED BECAUSE IT WAS DISPUTED. cc reported that `prez showreel build` does not exist and that prez answers `unknown command 'showreel'`. Measured four ways before this row was graded, all returning `showreel: check needs a directory` at rc=2: `bin/prez`, `bin/utilz prez`, PATH `prez` and PATH `utilz prez` -- and `~/.local/bin/prez` and `~/.local/bin/utilz` both symlink to the repo's `bin/utilz`. cc's own diagnosis afterwards: they had tested `target/release/prez`, a DIFFERENT executable whose verbs are build/pdf/present/browser, where `bin/prez` is the utilz DISPATCHER routing an exact `showreel` first argument at `opt/prez/prez:152`. The dispatch landed at `b8dc9f1` on 2026-09-09 and `main.rs`'s own module doc still said it was unwired, so a stale comment agreed with the mis-measurement and neither caught the other.
SIX ARTIFACTS, ONE SHA, ACROSS TWO SESSIONS AND FOUR INVOCATION ROUTES. `118a63f793122e90c9e5aecc8c74bdd474d709101be9fa25078d23466a233c84`, 5,462,781 bytes: cc's four -- two PATH forms (`<reel>/showreel` and the parent) and two COMMAND forms -- plus vc's two, built independently in a different scratch directory. **The build is deterministic across invocation route AND across sessions**, which is strictly more than this row asked for and is the reason the two axes are recorded separately rather than collapsed.
AND THE ROW IS GRADED ON A BUILD THAT CARRIES A DEFECT'S FIX, NOT ON THE FIRST ONE THAT RAN. The first structural compare found one difference in 23 slides: slide 7 `h` 1396 in the reference against 1397 in the port. **Python's `round()` is ties-to-even and Rust's `f64::round()` is ties-away-from-zero**, and `02-burning-city-45h.jpg` is 2560x1862, so at target 1920 the scale is exactly 0.75 and `1862 * 0.75 = 1396.5` with no floating-point slop at all. One asset of fourteen. Verified independently by vc with `decimal` rather than a repr, and confirmed AT THE ARTIFACT rather than at the code: slide 7 reads `1920x1396`. Fixed with `round_ties_even()` at `4a800d6`.
WHY THAT DEFECT SURVIVED 289 TESTS IS WORTH RECORDING ON THIS ROW, BECAUSE IT IS THE ARGUMENT FOR GRADING AGAINST A LIVE REEL AT ALL. Landing on an exact half is a property of the INPUT, and every fixture in the crate is one we chose. Nobody chooses 2560x1862. **The live reel was not a richer version of our fixtures -- it contained a value class our fixtures could not contain.**
WHAT THIS ROW DOES NOT COVER, STATED SO ITS GREEN IS NOT OVER-READ: no pixel comparison has run, and none is claimed. `--out` also suppresses pruning, so the `-001`/`-002` slot rotation is exercised by unit tests and not by this build -- ruled deliberately, because `_out/` is the promote source and an ungraded artifact sitting there can be promoted by accident. Slot behaviour belongs to WP-06. snorkeltoast's `_out/` is byte-untouched at a single `-001`, verified.
